legal.diagnosticoA: a) Once the diagnosis is completed or advanced, no repair will be carried out without the customer's express authorization, which may be given in writing, digitally, or verbally, with a record kept in the company's system.
legal.diagnosticoB: b) When preliminary technical work is essential to confirm the diagnosis — especially for corrective maintenance services, ultrasonic cleaning, or software errors (OS, BIOS, locks, and similar) — the customer agrees to pay for the work actually performed, even if they decide not to proceed with further repairs.
legal.diagnosticoC: c) Likewise, the customer authorizes the company to carry out any necessary technical tests, including partial or full disassembly of the equipment, without this implying responsibility for pre-existing damage, normal wear, service life, or hidden faults.
legal.ingreso: We do not guarantee that equipment will be returned in full or partial working condition if it is received at the shop turned off, showing signs of moisture damage, physical abuse, improper handling, general or excessive dirt/grime, more than five years of use, or if it cannot be fully tested at intake.
legal.ingreso2: During diagnosis, repair, or maintenance, such equipment may develop new faults or even fail to power on, and therefore any warranty on the work performed is expressly excluded.
legal.ingreso3: Hinges that are dented, excessively tightened, or deteriorated may cause screen damage (such as lines, stains, or spots), as well as affect the camera, microphone, or WiFi module, before or during the repair. Likewise, for screen replacements, no warranty will be granted if, after the equipment is delivered, lines, stains, dead pixels, or touch-function failures (total or partial) appear, since such conditions are usually caused by impacts or undue pressure applied to the screen.
legal.ingreso4: Access to the equipment's main account and/or an administrator user is required to run general and stress tests.
legal.ingresoNota: * The customer must disclose in good faith any information relevant to the diagnosis or repair of the equipment. Corporate configurations, VPN use, security locks, accessibility settings, parental controls, boot locks, BIOS locks, BitLocker locks, or similar features may affect the equipment's proper functioning. In such cases, the company CANNOT BE HELD RESPONSIBLE for the full or partial proper functioning of the equipment received.
legal.notasContrasena: Password: Without the password we cannot verify that the equipment works correctly, in full or in part.
legal.notasFallasOcultas: Hidden faults: Every piece of equipment received undergoes a basic (level 1) pre-diagnostic, since hidden damage may exist that could cause functioning problems. Electrical faults (charger, battery, connectors, charging jack, charging lines) can cause permanent damage to the equipment even if it is received powered on. Lack of maintenance can damage parts or the equipment as a whole. Equipment without recent maintenance (within the last 6 months) does not qualify for WARRANTY.
legal.notasRespaldos: Backups: Backups do not include programs or drivers. Hard drives with health below 70% may cause slowness, overheating, or various performance issues.
legal.notasSoftware: Software: NO WARRANTY IS OFFERED ON SOFTWARE.
legal.garantia: The WARRANTY, stamped on the invoice, covers exclusively the work performed and applies only once. It does not cover damage caused by moisture, electrical surges (including the use of unsuitable, non-original, or damaged chargers), failures caused by impacts, pressure, or tampering after the repair, nor prior interventions by other repair shops or by the customer. WE DO NOT ISSUE REFUNDS. Once approved (in writing, by phone call, message, stamped quote, or purchase order), the full cost of any repair must be assumed 100% by the customer. Additional faults beyond those quoted may delay the final delivery time and alter the initial estimate.
legal.garantia2: The diagnostic fee ranges between $20 and $100, depending on the equipment and its level of complexity. Pre-diagnostics start at $10. The customer acknowledges that additional faults not evident at the time of intake may be detected during the process, and the company is not responsible for them. It is the customer's responsibility to log out of email, social media, and other accounts before handing over the equipment; RCP is not responsible for the use of such accounts or for the loss of information on hard drives, memory devices, or other media during diagnosis or repair.
legal.garantia3: By signing, the customer declares that the equipment delivered is their own property. The equipment must be picked up within a maximum period of 45 days after notice that it is ready; after that period, a storage fee of C$100 per day may (optionally) be charged, up to a maximum total of 60 days, after which the company assumes no further responsibility whatsoever, in accordance with the Regulations of Ley 842. If parts are unavailable, the customer has up to two months from the equipment's intake date to pick it up; failure to do so will result in the equipment being considered abandoned. Check payments must be made out to Albert N. Palacios González.
legal.garantiaNota: * The customer must present this document in order to pick up the equipment, and must thoroughly verify the condition in which it is received, in order to reduce claims once the equipment has been delivered and has left the shop.
